submitted.rationale: I started at the NiSb2O6 trirutile composition, about 0.667 Sb (index 21), then moved toward more Sb. EQE rose steeply with Sb content: 0.015% at 0.66 Sb, 0.041% at 0.78 Sb and 1.08% at 0.83 Sb. Index 30, the most Sb-rich composition in the library, was the best of the three measured.
